description: This file defines the InstallationDatabaseAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, which provides an API endpoint for creating a database during the installation process. It extends a base REST controller and handles POST requests to initiate database creation, including error handling for invalid arguments.

classes.name: InstallationDatabaseAPI
classes.description: Provides an API for initiating database creation during the installation process, handling POST requests and error scenarios.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a database, returning success or error information based on execution.
